About Coppergate Ceramics

Coppergate Ceramics is a small pottery in York making wheel-thrown stoneware tableware for home cooks and independent restaurants. The studio was founded in 2015 by Nell Achterberg.

Browse the collection

The studio

Three potters work from the Walmgate studio. We fire twice a week in a 12 cubic foot electric kiln.

Training and residencies

Nell trained at the Harrogate School of Art and worked in Mashiko for two years. The studio takes one resident potter each autumn.

Stockists

Our pieces are stocked by four independent shops in Yorkshire and by one in Copenhagen.
